purpose: Teach: デルタ/ウーマン/典範/陸自/朝鮮総連/全曲/平凡社/魅惑

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、デルタ波の睡眠脳波を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're researching delta-wave sleep patterns as a team here.
lines.style: Clear, professional opener. Steady eye contact. Measured pace—informative without rushing. The voice of someone used to explaining complex things simply.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、女性ウーマン医療相談を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes, we also provide women's health consultations through our medical team.
lines.style: Reassuring, matter-of-fact. Slight warmth under the professionalism. Even pacing. The tone that says 'this is standard care, and we take it seriously.'

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、典範に従う医療倫理を医療チームで遵守します
lines.en: Ren, we maintain strict medical ethics standards—it's part of how we operate.
lines.style: Firm but not stern. Weight on the commitment. Slow, deliberate delivery. The voice of someone stating a principle, not apologizing for it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 陸自との災害時連携を、貴院、おこなわれてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does coordinate with the Self-Defense Forces during disasters, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Slight hesitation—he's asking something that matters to him. Respectful lilt at the end. Not challenging, observing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、朝鮮総連からの医療相談にも医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes, we also respond to health inquiries from various community organizations.
lines.style: Steady, inclusive tone. Brief pause before 'various'—choosing words carefully. Professional but human. No defensiveness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者のヘッドホン全曲チェックを医療チームでおこないません
lines.en: No, we don't have patients listen to every song in their medical file—that would be impractical.
lines.style: Dry, subtle humor beneath. Light, almost wry. A small smile in the voice. Not mocking; gently deflating an odd concern.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 平凡社の医学辞典を、貴院、参考にされてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does reference the Heibonsha Medical Dictionary, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Curious, genuinely interested. Softer attack than the previous question. Lean-in quality—he's testing whether she notices he's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、魅惑的香りの効能を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, we're also researching the therapeutic effects of aromatherapy as part of our practice.
lines.style: Open, accepting tone. Slight warmth—she's not dismissive of unconventional approaches. Even pacing. The voice saying 'we consider many things in care.'
